name: Bollworm
desc: Bollworm (Helicoverpa zea): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Helicoverpa zea, commonly known as the corn earworm, is a species (formerly in the genus Heliothis) in the family Noctuidae. The larva of the moth Helicoverpa zea is a major agricultural pest.
